title: Generosity without a demand for repayment

captions.physics: Agreeing fair terms for shared leisure

meaning: Fair terms and gentleness support shared pleasure when adding pleasant details quietly increases expectations of the evening.
text: Shared enjoyment can have clear terms and generous content. Justice in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps you agree on time, spending and participation by both. The Empress in energy leans towards an increasingly abundant leisure, adding pleasing details. Strength in emotions allows gentleness among strong expectations. It helps you notice when the initially free agreement no longer fits the expanded idea and discuss that without pressure on either person. The agreement concerns your actions, abundance drives the preparation, and steadiness belongs to how you experience it.

Suppose you plan a small dinner tasting cheeses. Initially you agree on a few flavours, but the list grows with the wish to make the evening special. **Generous enjoyment creates no debt for every prepared detail.** You can choose less and leave the rest for another time. Agreement, conversation and permission to recognise satisfaction preserve participation, beyond an obligation to appreciate the whole selection equally highly and enthusiastically.

If gentleness becomes concealing discomfort, the initial fairness fades. You accept further preparations while inwardly comparing effort with reaction. Leisure leaves a sense of an unspoken account. Steadiness helps when it permits boundaries to be named early. A small evening can be complete without expanding the programme, given free agreement and pleasure in what you actually want to share now.
